title: OSHA construction stairways and ladders practice questions
description: Free practice questions on OSHA construction stairways and ladders (29 CFR 1926 Subpart X). Every answer is explained and linked to the rule text.

questions.question: Under Subpart X, which other subpart contains additional requirements for ladders used on or with scaffolds?

options.A: Subpart L (Scaffolds)
options.B: Subpart P (Excavations)
options.C: Subpart K (Electrical)
options.D: Subpart E (Personal Protective and Life Saving Equipment)

questions.explanation: Subpart X says "Additional requirements for ladders used on or with scaffolds are contained in subpart L—Scaffolds."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1050, Scope, application, and definitions applicable to this subpart (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: A building has only one point of access between levels, and upcoming work will restrict free passage at that point. What does Subpart X require?

options.A: Work may go ahead if a warning sign is posted at the access point
options.B: A second point of access must be provided and used
options.C: Employees must stay on one level until the work is done
options.D: The existing ladder must be replaced with a double-cleated ladder

questions.explanation: "When work must be performed or equipment must be used such that free passage at that point of access is restricted, a second point of access shall be provided and used."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1051, General requirements (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: By when must the employer have installed the stairway and ladder fall protection systems that Subpart X requires?

options.A: Within 30 days after work starts
options.B: Once the building is fully enclosed
options.C: Before the final inspection of the project
options.D: Before employees begin the work that necessitates the installation and use of the stairways, ladders and their fall protection systems

questions.explanation: Employers must install those systems and comply with the subpart "before employees begin the work that necessitates the installation and use of stairways, ladders, and their respective fall protection systems."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1051, General requirements (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: What does Subpart X say about spiral stairways that will not be a permanent part of the structure being built?

options.A: They may be used if they have a handrail on both sides
options.B: They may be used only by one employee at a time
options.C: Employees shall not use them
options.D: They may be used only during daylight hours

questions.explanation: "Employees shall not use any spiral stairways that will not be a permanent part of the structure on which construction work is being performed."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1051, General requirements (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Outside of stairway construction itself, when may employees walk on pan stairs whose treads will be filled with concrete later?

options.A: When the stairs are temporarily fitted with wood or other solid material at least to the top edge of each pan
options.B: When employees walk single file
options.C: When warning signs are posted at both ends
options.D: When handrails are installed on both sides

questions.explanation: Foot traffic on such stairs is prohibited "unless the stairs are temporarily fitted with wood or other solid material at least to the top edge of each pan."

questions.question: How must treads for temporary service be installed on a stair?

options.A: Across at least half the width of the stair
options.B: On every other step
options.C: The full width and depth of the stair
options.D: Only at the landings

questions.explanation: "Treads for temporary service shall be made of wood or other solid material, and shall be installed the full width and depth of the stair."

questions.question: A stairway has a slippery spot. When must that condition be eliminated?

options.A: At the end of the shift
options.B: Before the stairway is used to reach other levels
options.C: At the next weekly inspection
options.D: Only after someone slips

questions.explanation: "Slippery conditions on stairways shall be eliminated before the stairways are used to reach other levels."

questions.question: What must be provided along the unprotected sides and edges of stairway landings?

options.A: Warning signs
options.B: Caution tape
options.C: A safety monitor
options.D: Guardrail systems

questions.explanation: "Unprotected sides and edges of stairway landings shall be provided with guardrail systems."

questions.question: A crew builds a temporary wooden handrail and stairrail system for a stairway. How must their surfaces be finished?

options.A: Painted safety yellow
options.B: Wrapped in caution tape
options.C: So as to prevent punctures or lacerations and to prevent snagging of clothing
options.D: Left rough so they give a firmer grip

questions.explanation: "Stairrail systems and handrails shall be so surfaced as to prevent injury to employees from punctures or lacerations, and to prevent snagging of clothing."

questions.question: What must be provided between the top rail of a stairrail system and the stairway steps?

options.A: Midrails, screens, mesh, intermediate vertical members, or equivalent intermediate structural members
options.B: Nothing; the space must be left open for cleaning
options.C: A second handrail only
options.D: A toeboard only

questions.explanation: "Midrails, screens, mesh, intermediate vertical members, or equivalent intermediate structural members, shall be provided between the top rail of the stairrail system and the stairway steps."

questions.question: On a construction stairway, a door opens directly onto the stairs. What does Subpart X require at that spot?

options.A: The door must be kept locked until construction ends
options.B: A platform, with the door's swing leaving the platform at least 20 inches of effective width
options.C: Only a warning sign on the door
options.D: A handrail across the door opening

questions.explanation: "Where doors or gates open directly on a stairway, a platform shall be provided, and the swing of the door shall not reduce the effective width of the platform to less than 20 inches (51 cm)."

questions.question: What must each stepladder be provided with to hold its front and back sections open while it is used?

options.A: A rope tied between the sections
options.B: A wood block wedged between the rails
options.C: A second worker holding the sections apart
options.D: A metal spreader or locking device

questions.explanation: "A metal spreader or locking device shall be provided on each stepladder to hold the front and back sections in an open position when the ladder is being used."

questions.question: When may two ladders be tied or fastened together to make a longer section?

options.A: Only when they are specifically designed for such use
options.B: Whenever both ladders are extra-heavy-duty type 1A
options.C: Whenever a competent person supervises the job
options.D: Whenever the joint is lashed with wire rope

questions.explanation: "Ladders shall not be tied or fastened together to provide longer sections unless they are specifically designed for such use."

questions.question: A fixed ladder with a total length of climb of 24 feet or more uses self-retracting lifelines. What is the longest interval the rule allows between the required rest platforms?

options.A: 200 feet
options.B: 300 feet
options.C: 150 feet
options.D: 500 feet

questions.explanation: One of the permitted options for such fixed ladders is "Self-retracting lifelines, and rest platforms at intervals not to exceed 150 feet (45.7 m)."

questions.question: A ladder must stand in a doorway where passing workplace traffic could knock it over. What does the rule require?

options.A: Only a warning sign on the ladder
options.B: The ladder must be secured to prevent accidental displacement, or a barricade must keep the traffic away from it
options.C: Slip-resistant feet on the ladder, and nothing more
options.D: Nothing, if the ladder is a stepladder

questions.explanation: Ladders placed where workplace activities or traffic can displace them, "such as in passageways, doorways, or driveways, shall be secured to prevent accidental displacement, or a barricade shall be used to keep the activities or traffic away from the ladder."

questions.question: Unless it has a single support attachment, how must the top of a non-self-supporting ladder be placed?

options.A: Resting on one rail
options.B: Resting on the top rung only
options.C: Tied to another ladder above it
options.D: With the two rails supported equally

questions.explanation: "The top of a non-self-supporting ladder shall be placed with the two rails supported equally unless it is equipped with a single support attachment."

questions.question: A damaged ladder has been repaired. What must the repair have achieved before the ladder goes back into use?

options.A: Restored the ladder to a condition meeting its original design criteria
options.B: Been marked with the repair date only
options.C: Been painted over so the damage no longer shows
options.D: Nothing; repaired ladders may be used for light work right away

questions.explanation: "Ladder repairs shall restore the ladder to a condition meeting its original design criteria, before the ladder is returned to use."

questions.question: A ladder has to be set up on ground that is not stable and level. Under what condition does the rule allow it to be used there?

options.A: If it will be used for less than 15 minutes
options.B: If the user carries no tools
options.C: If it is secured to prevent accidental displacement
options.D: If it is a fiberglass ladder

questions.explanation: "Ladders shall be used only on stable and level surfaces unless secured to prevent accidental displacement."

questions.question: A ladder is used on a flat metal surface that cannot be kept from becoming slippery. What does the rule say about slip-resistant feet in that case?

options.A: Slip-resistant feet alone make the setup acceptable
options.B: They shall not be used as a substitute for care in placing, lashing, or holding the ladder
options.C: Slip-resistant feet are prohibited on metal surfaces
options.D: They are required only indoors

questions.explanation: "Slip-resistant feet shall not be used as a substitute for care in placing, lashing, or holding a ladder that is used upon slippery surfaces including, but not limited to, flat metal or concrete surfaces that are constructed so they cannot be prevented from becoming slippery."

questions.question: Which of these is listed as an area in which employees using ladders and stairways must be trained, as applicable?

options.A: How to apply for an OSHA inspection
options.B: Ladder sales and pricing
options.C: First aid certification
options.D: The maximum intended load-carrying capacities of ladders used

questions.explanation: Employees must be "trained by a competent person" in listed areas, as applicable, including "The maximum intended load-carrying capacities of ladders used."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1060, Training requirements (as of Nov 3, 2026)
